added_models.model: Cortisone reductase deficiency: people with loss-of-function HSD11B1 or H6PD genotypes

engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading (Nat Genet, paywalled). CRD was described clinically before 2003; the genetic lesion dates the model, proxy allowed. No FDA review exists for this class (nothing approved), so model_filed cannot be read from a filing.
engagement.note: People lacking 11β-HSD1 oxoreductase activity: cortisone is not regenerated to cortisol, read as a shifted urinary cortisol:cortisone metabolite signature.
engagement.quote: In cortisone reductase deficiency (CRD), activation of cortisone to cortisol does not occur, resulting in adrenocorticotropin-mediated androgen excess and a phenotype resembling polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS; refs. 1,2).
engagement.judgement: Opens the human-genetic track at the first genetic identification of CRD (digenic HSD11B1/H6PD); Lawson 2011 later found HSD11B1 coding mutations, the direct genetic analog of pharmacological inhibition. No drug is given, so product_in_model is false.

engagement.magnitude_basis: urinary cortisol:cortisone metabolite ratio, direction only; no per-cent inhibition in the abstract
engagement.confidence_note: Abstract only (paywalled); NCT00823680 posted no results. Model side is Lavery 2008 (24-h urinary steroid biomarkers by GC/MS define CRD); the pairing with the trial is the drafter's. No FDA review exists for this class (nothing approved), so model_filed cannot be read from a filing.
engagement.note: RO5093151 200 mg bid for 28 days in metformin-treated T2D shifted urinary corticosteroid excretion, the GC/MS steroid signature that defines CRD.
engagement.short: CRD urinary steroid signature reproduced by drug
engagement.quote: Both compounds were well tolerated and showed inhibitory effects on 11β-HSD1 activity based on urinary corticosteroid excretion.
engagement.reason: Urinary steroid signature of CRD reproduced
engagement.judgement: Proximal: the urinary tetrahydro-metabolite ratio is the enzyme product, the same readout the genetic model is diagnosed on. BI 187004 (Bianzano 2023, decreased (THF+alloTHF)/THE ratio) repeats it and does not change the status.

safety.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading (Nat Genet, paywalled). No FDA review exists for this class (nothing approved), so model_filed cannot be read from a filing.
safety.note: Lifelong loss of cortisol regeneration drives ACTH and adrenal androgens up: a prediction that inhibition will activate the HPA axis and raise adrenal androgens.
safety.quote: In cortisone reductase deficiency (CRD), activation of cortisone to cortisol does not occur, resulting in adrenocorticotropin-mediated androgen excess and a phenotype resembling polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS; refs. 1,2).
safety.judgement: The harm the genotype predicts is on-target (HPA activation with adrenal androgen excess), so it is pooled, not split by modality.

safety.magnitude_basis: ACTH and adrenal androgen precursors, direction only; CRD shows clinical hyperandrogenism, the trial a within-range rise
safety.confidence_note: Abstract only (paywalled); NCT00823680 posted no results. Model side is Lawson 2011 (heterozygous HSD11B1 R137C/K187N, 'typified by increased cortisol clearance and androgen excess'); pairing is the drafter's. No FDA review exists for this class (nothing approved), so model_filed cannot be read from a filing.
safety.note: RO5093151 raised ACTH and adrenal androgen precursors in T2D patients over 28 days, the ACTH-mediated adrenal androgen drive the CRD genotype shows.
safety.short: ACTH and adrenal androgens rose in T2D
safety.quote: As reported for other 11β-HSD1-inhibitors increased concentrations of ACTH and adrenal androgen precursors were found with RO-151, but not with RO-838.
safety.judgement: Same in direction. The genetic model is lifelong complete loss and presents as hirsutism/PCOS; 28 days of drug gave a within-range rise, so magnitude is direction_only and nothing in the model mis-sized a clinical harm.

safety.magnitude_basis: androstenedione, DHEA-S and ACTH, direction only; all stayed within the normal range
safety.confidence_note: Full text read (open access, PMC9811530); NCT01874483 posted no results. The paper attributes the expected androgen rise to earlier inhibitor trials, not to CRD; pairing is the drafter's. No FDA review exists for this class (nothing approved), so model_filed cannot be read from a filing.
safety.note: BI 187004 10-360 mg for 14 days in 71 T2D patients raised ACTH, androstenedione and DHEA-S in both sexes, within range, reversing on discontinuation.
safety.short: Adrenal androgens up again, within range
safety.quote: In detail, mean androstenedione and DHEA-s levels increased slightly in both genders without any dose dependency and decreased after discontinuation of treatment.
safety.reason: ACTH-driven adrenal androgen rise, within range
safety.judgement: Strengthens the 2014 match with a direct adrenal-androgen readout for a second member; the 28-day study (Bianzano 2023: 'increased ACTH and androstenedione ... within the normal range') repeats it. The genetic model over-predicts magnitude, not direction.

added_models.model: Rat ex-vivo adipose 11β-HSD1 activity after 7-9 days' continuous dosing with sibling inhibitors (AZD8329, COMPOUND-20)

engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading (full text not retrieved; rat strain not read). The paper's own human arm is AZD8329, a non-member, so its stated rat-vs-human comparison does not score. No FDA review exists for this class (nothing approved), so model_filed cannot be read from a filing.
engagement.note: Rat adipose lost 11β-HSD1 inhibition after 7-9 days of continuous inhibitor cover, as did human adipose on AZD8329; mouse adipose did not.
engagement.short: Rat predicts adipose tachyphylaxis on repeat dosing
engagement.quote: Human and rat AT, but not mouse AT, exhibited tachyphylaxis for inhibition of 11β-HSD1 activity after repeat dosing.
engagement.judgement: A separate track from the DIO mouse: a different species whose prediction (loss of adipose inhibition under continuous cover) is the opposite of the mouse's. Dosed with sibling compounds only, so product_in_model is false.

engagement.magnitude_basis: per-cent ex-vivo adipose inhibition after the 2nd vs the 14th daily dose; the rat predicted loss, patients kept 74-98 %
engagement.confidence_note: BI 187004 full text read (open access, PMC9811530); NCT01874483 posted no results. The rat loss was conditional on continuous drug cover; BI 187004 t1/2,ss 106-124 h gives continuous cover, so the condition was met. Rat paper abstract-level. No FDA review exists for this class (nothing approved), so model_filed cannot be read from a filing.
engagement.note: BI 187004 once daily for 14 days in T2D kept adipose 11β-HSD1 88-99% inhibited after dose 2 and 74-98% 24 h after dose 14: no tachyphylaxis.
engagement.short: Adipose inhibition held 14 days; no tachyphylaxis
engagement.quote: Median inhibition of 11beta-HSD1 in subcutaneous adipose tissue biopsies was 87.9-99.4% immediately after the second dose and 73.8-97.5% 24 h after the last dose of BI 187004.
engagement.reason: Predicted loss of inhibition did not occur
engagement.judgement: Contra: the rat predicted loss of adipose inhibition within 7-9 days of continuous cover and the member drug held 74-98 % at trough after 14 daily doses. The alternative reading, that tachyphylaxis is compound-specific (reversible vs pseudo-irreversible binders) rather than a species property, would make the rat prediction conditional rather than wrong; the source framed it as a species property, so it is scored as one.

added_models.model: PBPK model of BMS-823778 built on in-vitro metabolism and healthy-volunteer PK, simulating CYP2C19/UGT1A4 genotypes and DDI

dose.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading (full text PMC5980543 not retrieved). The healthy-volunteer studies' registry IDs are not in the abstract. No FDA review exists for this class (nothing approved), so model_filed cannot be read from a filing.
dose.note: A PBPK model of BMS-823778 built and verified on existing clinical PK, then used to simulate exposure by CYP2C19/UGT1A4 genotype and itraconazole DDI.
dose.short: PBPK model built on existing human PK
dose.quote: The PBPK model was built and verified using existing clinical data.
dose.judgement: Opens the in-silico track at publication; the model postdates the programme's clinical PK (2017-2018 papers) and its DDI/genotype simulations were never tested because the programme had ended.

dose.magnitude_basis: predicted vs observed BMS-823778 exposure by CYP2C19 genotype; the acceptance fold is not in the abstract
dose.population: Healthy volunteers genotyped for CYP2C19 (incl. Chinese and Japanese cohorts)
dose.confidence_note: Abstract only; the predicted/observed fold criterion is unverified. The model recovers the same clinical data it was built from, hence retro. No FDA review exists for this class (nothing approved), so model_filed cannot be read from a filing.
dose.note: The verified PBPK model reproduced observed BMS-823778 PK across populations and the 5-fold higher exposure in CYP2C19 poor metabolizers.
dose.quote: The verified PBPK model of BMS-823778 accurately recovered observed PK in different populations.
dose.reason: Retrodiction of known PK, never run prospectively
dose.judgement: Retro, not same: the model was built on the human PK it recovers (decision 10). It sets no efficacy exposure target, so margin_stated is false; prediction_level is class because it predicts exposure by genotype, not response. Its prospective DDI predictions were never tested.

considered_not_added: 11β-HSD1 knockout mouse as an EFFICACY model (Kotelevtsev 1997: -/- mice 'resist hyperglycemia provoked by obesity or stress'; Morton 2004, Diabetes 53:931, resistance to diet-induced obesity) contradicted by BI 187004 at complete inhibition (Vitae 8-K 2015-06-29/2015-12-17, Bianzano 2023): the system already has a track in the draft (hsd11b1-ko-mouse, safety), so the efficacy opener (1997, untested) and the 2015/2022 contra belong on that track, not in added_models.

Mouse ex-vivo adipose repeat-dose assay (Morentin Gutierrez 2015: inhibition 'was not lost in mouse AT after continuous cover'), which BI 187004's sustained adipose inhibition agrees with: same system as the dio-mouse engagement track already scored same; the paper's own human arm is AZD8329, a non-member, and does not score.

S-707106 phase I/IIa in Cushing's syndrome / autonomous cortisol secretion (Oda 2021, doi:10.1210/clinem/dgab450; n=16, open-label; OGTT-AUC responder primary not met): outside the T2D context, and any HPA/adrenal-androgen safety import would sit on the existing hsd11b1-ko-mouse track or the CRD track; the abstract reports no HPA data and the full text is paywalled (fc.py returned navigation only), so nothing is quotable; its registry ID is not in the abstract and ClinicalTrials.gov holds no record. The draft's 'S-707106 never reported' should be read as the T2D trial NCT01240759 only.

BMS-823778 cynomolgus acute-PD model (Li 2018, ED50 0.6 mg/kg): the human data are CYP2C19-genotype PK only (Cheng 2018 doi:10.1111/bcp.13421, [14C] ADME in EM vs PM; Gong 2018 doi:10.1124/dmd.117.078824, SAD/MAD PK; abstracts verified), with no human PD readout, so the monkey PD was never compared.

BI 187004 target-mediated-drug-disposition population PK model (Yuan & An 2024, doi:10.1002/jcph.2438) and the class TMDD review (An & Katz 2023, doi:10.1002/jcph.2185): fitted to the human data after the programme ended and offered for 'future' dose selection; describes, never predicted, so no comparison to score.
HSD11B1 common-variant association / Mendelian-randomisation genetics as a human-genetic efficacy model: Europe PMC search found no source comparing variant carriers with any inhibitor-trial result.
Human cortisone/prednisone-conversion challenge as a PD model: found only for the non-member MK-0916 in healthy subjects (doi:10.1111/bcp.12131, not read); no member-drug paper found.

JTT-654 in hypertensive / diabetic-kidney rats (2024, doi:10.1016/j.jphs.2024.02.001): a further rat system for a member, but JTT-654 has no public patient result to compare (NCT00997152 terminated 2010, unreported).
Clofutriben (SPI-62) human adipose tachyphylaxis study (2025, doi:10.1111/cts.70398): non-member, does not score.
